extra_quotes: Each selected test is then re-run at its original seed with waveform dumping enabled for the target module, so that the ACC sees exactly the behavior the passing regression produced.
For each assertion, JasperGold also checks a cover property on its antecedent, which identifies vacuous proofs.
Activating a non-activated mutant would require new stimulus, which is outside the scope of this work: the framework inspects the regression tests the team already runs.

The 13 mutants the ACC did not observe share one pattern: its report was taken by a contradiction that the unmodified reference also shows, such as the command-ready flag of CSRNG or the disabled channel of PATTGEN.
